reviewer: Codex original-source review with independent coordinator review
scope: Correction to exactly forty previously published Russian Higher summary tasks; no new source-coverage claim.
problem: Whole-response language adjustment previously removed manual discretionary marks despite a specific source exception allowing discretion for substantial understanding that is not expressed in intelligible English.
resolution: Retain every language flag and content adjustment. Exempt only the existing top-level manual summary-skills criterion from the whole-response multiplier, after applying all original discretionary caps. No automatic award and no invented wholly/mixed language threshold.
sourceDifferences: 2013 permits Russian-language words; later reviewed schemes distinguish discretionary marks from content and specify an excessive number of Russian-language words. Each sitting retains its own exact clause.
